pieces.title: banana republican / banana weather
pieces.text: Real time weather RSS feed drives changes in the composition. Heat, humidity, wind, cloud cover etc. are tracked through the web. Flash based AIR application; a random generative non real time version is available in C++. Software on computer. Edition of 8 with 2 APs. Videos and prints.

pieces.title: proof of life
pieces.text: A fake news generator. A BBC RSS feed provides a live news feed that is combined with additional texts from the artist, Obama and Trump to complete each article. Names of papers are now defunct US print media; they change when the news is updated. The tree in the foreground changes to red and green during market hours to reflect financial index changes. Software on computer. Edition of 5 with 2 APs. Videos and prints.

pieces.title: the money pit
pieces.text: Watercolors, video, animation and software. RSS financial live feed drives color changes on the iguana: red down, green up, neutral when the market is closed. Software on computer. Edition of 8 with 2 APs. Videos and prints.
